title: CRE8 Design System - AIDesign System Specification
description: AI Design System Schema for CRE8 Web Components

button-group.name: Button Group
button-group.description: Container for grouping related buttons with consistent spacing and responsive layout.

enumValues.description: Stacks on mobile, inline on desktop

button.name: Button
button.description: Primary interaction element for user actions. Supports multiple visual variants, icons, loading states, and can render as a link.
whenToUse: Triggering a discrete action (save, submit, delete)

whenNotToUse.scenario: Navigating to another page without action

enumValues.description: Highest emphasis, for the main action
enumValues.semanticHint: Limit to ONE per view. Use for: save, submit, confirm, primary CTA.
Use for: cancel, back, secondary options
Use sparingly - consider if a cre8-link is more appropriate

antiPatterns: Multiple primary buttons in same view

enumValues.description: Compact, for dense UIs or inline actions
Default size for most use cases
Prominent, for primary CTAs or touch targets

type.description: HTML button type for form behavior

href.description: Converts button to anchor tag for navigation

antiPatterns: Using href for actions that modify state

target.description: Link target window (only when href is set)

hideText.description: Visually hide text but keep for accessibility

loading.description: Shows loading indicator and prevents interaction

loadingComplete.description: Loading has finished (shows success state briefly)

events.name: click
events.description: Fired when the button is activated
events.trigger: User clicks, taps, or presses Enter/Space while focused

requiredAttributes: text (always required for screen readers, even with hideText)

announcements.onStateChange: Loading state and disabled state announced via ariaLive

recommendedWith.reason: To explain icon-only buttons or disabled state

examples.name: Link Button
examples.description: Button that navigates to external page

checkbox-field-item.name: Checkbox Field Item
checkbox-field-item.description: Individual checkbox input with label. Can be used standalone or within cre8-checkbox-field.

examples.name: Terms Agreement
examples.code: <cre8-checkbox-field-item label="I agree to the terms and conditions" required></cre8-checkbox-field-item>

checkbox-field.name: Checkbox Field
checkbox-field.description: Group container for checkbox inputs. Use for multiple selections from a set of options.
whenToUse: Multiple selections from a small set (2-7 options)
Boolean choices that need explicit labels

examples.name: Interests Selection
examples.code:
<cre8-checkbox-field legend="Select your interests">
  <cre8-checkbox-field-item label="Sports" value="sports"></cre8-checkbox-field-item>
  <cre8-checkbox-field-item label="Music" value="music"></cre8-checkbox-field-item>
</cre8-checkbox-field>

danger-button.name: Danger Button
danger-button.description: Button for potentially destructive actions. Same API as cre8-button but with danger color scheme.

date-picker.name: Date Picker
date-picker.description: Date input with calendar functionality. Extends cre8-field with date-specific features.

hasShortcuts.description: Show date shortcuts like Today, Tomorrow

field.name: Field
field.description: Standard form input with label, helper text, and validation states. Supports multiple input types including text, email, password, number, date, etc.
whenToUse: Date inputs (consider cre8-date-picker for complex scenarios)
Any form field requiring label and validation

type.description: Input type affecting keyboard, validation, and behavior

antiPatterns: Using text for emails/phones (loses mobile keyboard benefits)

required.description: Field is required for form submission

errorNote.description: Error message displayed when isError is true

successNote.description: Success message displayed when isSuccess is true

ariaDescribedBy.description: ID of element describing the field

ariaLive.description: Screen reader update mode for validation

slots.name: fieldNote
slots.description: Custom field note content (overrides fieldNote prop)

events.name: input
events.trigger: User types or modifies input value

events.name: change
events.description: Fired when input loses focus after change
events.trigger: User finishes editing and moves focus

announcements.onStateChange: Error and success states announced via ariaLive

examples.name: Email Field
examples.description: Standard email input with helper text
examples.code: <cre8-field type="email" label="Email Address" name="email" required fieldNote="We'll never share your email"></cre8-field>

examples.name: Error State
examples.code: <cre8-field type="text" label="Username" isError errorNote="Username already taken"></cre8-field>

examples.name: Password Field
examples.code: <cre8-field type="password" label="Password" required fieldNote="Minimum 8 characters" autocomplete="new-password"></cre8-field>

multi-select.name: Multi Select
multi-select.description: Dropdown that allows selecting multiple options. Shows selected items as removable tags.

radio-field-item.name: Radio Field Item
radio-field-item.description: Individual radio button input. Must be used with shared name attribute for grouping.
aiUsageRules: Radio buttons cannot be deselected once chosen
Group all related options with same name
Never use single radio button - use checkbox instead

radio-field.name: Radio Field
radio-field.description: Group container for radio button inputs. Use for single selection from mutually exclusive options.

examples.name: Payment Method
examples.code:
<cre8-radio-field legend="Payment Method">
  <cre8-radio-field-item label="Credit Card" name="payment" value="cc"></cre8-radio-field-item>
  <cre8-radio-field-item label="PayPal" name="payment" value="paypal"></cre8-radio-field-item>
</cre8-radio-field>

select-tile-list.name: Select Tile List
select-tile-list.description: Container for select tile components with layout and validation support.

select-tile.name: Select Tile
select-tile.description: Visual selection card as alternative to checkbox/radio. Supports rich content in slots.

select.name: Select
select.description: Dropdown selection from predefined options. Supports grouped options and standard form validation states.
whenToUse: Space is limited for displaying all options

items.description: Array of options or option groups

split-button.name: Split Button
split-button.description: Button with dropdown for additional actions. Primary action is directly clickable.

layout.name: Layout
layout.description: Page-level layout structure with optional sidebar.

slots.name: default
slots.description: Link or text for terminal node

breadcrumbs.name: Breadcrumbs
aiUsageRules: Last item is current page (not a link)
All other items should be interactive links
Shows hierarchy from root to current

link.name: Link
aiUsageRules: Use only for navigation - never for actions
Use ctaLink for prominent call-to-action links

pagination.name: Pagination
aiUsageRules: Push focus to results top after page change

tabs.name: Tabs
aiUsageRules: Tab labels should be short (1-2 words)
Equal number of tabs and panels

text-link.name: Text Link
text-link.description: Inline text link with style variants.

alert.name: Alert
aiUsageRules: Match status to severity (error > warning > info)
Use inverted buttons/links on strong emphasis

inline-alert.name: Inline Alert
inline-alert.description: Contextual inline message. Non-dismissible and minimally intrusive.
aiUsageRules: No title or close button - minimally intrusive

loading-spinner.name: Loading Spinner
aiUsageRules: Use determinate when progress is known

modal.name: Modal
modal.description: Dialog overlay for focused content or confirmation.

progress-steps.name: Progress Steps
aiUsageRules: Shows total steps, completion, and current position

skeleton-loader.name: Skeleton Loader
aiUsageRules: Use for initial page load only
Never skeleton modals, dropdowns, or loaders

accordion.name: Accordion
accordion.description: Expandable content sections for progressive disclosure.
aiUsageRules: Use for content that doesnt need to be visible all at once

badge.name: Badge
aiUsageRules: Use for counts, statuses, or categorization
Keep text very short (1-3 words or numbers)
Use status colors consistently across the app

card.name: Card
card.description: Contained content block for grouping related content.
aiUsageRules: Keep cards consistent in same context
If clickable, entire card should be interactive

feature.name: Feature
feature.description: Feature highlight component with icon and text.

decorative.description: If true, hidden from screen readers

table.name: Table
table.description: Structured data display with responsive support.
aiUsageRules: Use responsive for tables with many columns
Use striped for better row scanning

drawer.name: Drawer
drawer.description: Slide-in panel from edge of screen.

heading.name: Heading
heading.description: Semantic heading component with typography styles.

styleVariant.description: Visual style (can differ from semantic level)

aiUsageRules: Use tagVariant for semantic level (document outline)
Use styleVariant to override visual appearance

text-passage.name: Text Passage
text-passage.description: Container for body text with proper typography styling.

fieldset.name: Fieldset
aiUsageRules: Use for logically related form fields

form.name: Form
aiUsageRules: Handle both success and error events
Works with all Cre8 form components

skip-link.name: Skip Link
aiUsageRules: Place as first focusable element on page

visually-hidden.name: Visually Hidden
aiUsageRules: Use for accessible labels on icon-only buttons
Never use for hiding from all users
